archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Corporate Trust

buttons.primary: bg-[#2EC4B6] text-[#0A2540] font-semibold py-3 px-6 rounded-none border border-transparent hover:bg-[#20A89C] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2EC4B6] focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#0A2540] font-semibold py-3 px-6 rounded-none border border-[#0A2540] hover:bg-[#0A2540] hover:text-white transition-all
buttons.dark: bg-[#0A2540] text-white font-semibold py-3 px-6 rounded-none hover:bg-[#06182C] transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] p-8 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg

inputs.default: w-full border border-[#E2E8F0] bg-white px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2EC4B6] focus:border-transparent text-[#0F172A]

sections_instructions.Header: Sticky, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-b border-[#E2E8F0]. Include combined Droplets + Wrench lucide icons as logo. Desktop links and primary CTA. Mobile hamburger menu.
sections_instructions.Hero: Asymmetrical layout. Left: H1 '24/7 Emergency Plumbing in Brussels', Subtitle 'Fast. Reliable. Done Right the First Time.' CTAs, trust badges underneath. Right: Hero image (pexels-photo-33388390.jpeg) with slight offset background shape.
sections_instructions.Services: 7 services. Use bento grid. 6 items as standard white cards with Teal Lucide icons. 7th item (span-2 or wide) as a dark emergency card with dark abstract texture bg.
sections_instructions.Pricing: Transparent pricing header. 3 columns. Center card highlighted with a 'Tracing Beam' inspired Teal border or solid Teal line on top.
sections_instructions.Why Choose Us: 5 bullet points. Left column sticky text 'Why FlowFix?', Right column scrolling list. Numbers '01' to '05' in massive text-6xl text-[#E2E8F0] sitting behind the point text.
sections_instructions.Testimonials: 3 customer reviews in a masonry or 3-col grid. Include avatar images and star ratings (lucide Star icon, filled Teal).
sections_instructions.About Us: Local Brussels company story. Grid with text on left, Brussels cityscape image on right. Subtle background color #F8FAFC.
sections_instructions.Contact: Two-col layout. Left: Contact form (Name, Phone, Email, Service dropdown, Message) using native HTML forms (styled). Formspree action commented out. Right: Contact details (Address, Phone, Email) styled like an invoice or control panel.
sections_instructions.CTA Banner: Full width dark blue abstract texture bg. Large 'Need a Plumber Now?' text. Call Now button.
sections_instructions.Footer: Deep blue bg #0A2540. 4 columns: Brand info, Quick Links, Services, Contact Info. Social icons.

animation_rules.hero: Framer motion initial={opacity:0, y:30} animate={opacity:1, y:0} transition={duration:0.6}
animation_rules.stagger: List items should use staggerChildren for entry animations
animation_rules.interaction: All buttons must have active:scale-95 transition

accessibility.contrast: Text over dark backgrounds must be pure white #FFFFFF.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.
